artworks.title: Gabriel Cortois de Pressigny
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing in a slightly turned position with his head facing forward. He has distinct facial features, including a defined nose and relaxed expression. His hair is light and combed back gently. He is dressed in ornate clerical attire with intricate patterns on his sleeves and collar, and wears a large cross around his neck. His right hand rests on a document, while his left hand holds a book or similar object, resting on a table. The background is plain, with no additional details.

artworks.title: Odalisque
artworks.description: The image shows a woman reclining on a couch or bed. She is lying on her side with her upper torso supported by her left arm, and her legs are outstretched. She has an oval-shaped face, delicate features, and her hair is partially covered by a headscarf. The woman is unclothed, wearing only a bracelet and an anklet on her left wrist and ankle. The setting includes ornate textiles on the furniture and a detailed rug underneath. Heavy drapery hangs on one side, and there is a decorative incense burner nearby. The background consists of patterned fabric.

artworks.title: Holy Family and Four Saints
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed in yellow, green-gray, dark brown, and dark-gray on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a group of individuals engaged in a scene that appears to have religious significance. In the center, a woman is seated on a raised platform, holding a small child on her lap. The woman has long hair and delicate facial features, adorned in flowing robes. The child has curly hair and is depicted holding an object in each hand. Surrounding them are four other figures. To the left stands a winged figure with short hair, draped in a voluminous cloak, extending their hands toward the central figures. Another individual, bearded and dressed in layered garments, tends to the child, while another kneels with a contemplative expression. To the right, an elderly man holding a staff, wearing a long robe, gazes next to the central woman. Behind this assembly is a detailed backdrop featuring ornate patterns and architectural details, such as columns and drapery.

artworks.title: Vestiges d'un temple de la Grece
artworks.artist: Jean-François Janinet after Giovanni Paolo Panini
artworks.description: The image depicts ancient ruins with human figures. The foreground shows people interacting near classical architecture, including columns with Corinthian capitals. There is a fractured entablature and a circular stone piece nearby. A decorated urn stands on the right. The background blends the sky and distant landscape. The painting focuses on details in the architecture, figures' clothing, and classical style. The color palette consists of browns, beiges, greys, pale blues, and hints of green.

artworks.title: The Holy Family
artworks.description: The image depicts multiple figures in a classical composition. A young nude child reaches towards a woman in flowing drapery, who gazes down at the child. Another woman holds the child, while a second child stands nearby holding a small cross. An angelic figure hovers above with wings, presenting a bouquet. In the background, an older man sits with an introspective expression. The setting is majestic, with draped fabric suggesting an interior space, rendered in a soft monochromatic palette.

artworks.title: Edouard Gautier d'Agoty
artworks.artist: Carlo Lasinio after Johann Ernst Heinsius
artworks.description: The image features a person sitting in a three-quarter position, facing slightly to the right and looking at the viewer. The individual has light skin and curly light-colored hair under a wide-brimmed brown hat. They wear a brown coat over a white shirt with a distinctive collar. The person holds quills in one hand. The background is a muted greenish tone with a textured appearance, and there is no visible jewelry on the person.

artworks.title: Lucy Lawrence
artworks.artist: Frederick Christian Lewis I after Sir Thomas Lawrence
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman in period attire, seated and facing the viewer. She has expressive eyes, curly dark hair, and is wearing a bonnet and a shawl. The background is plain with subtle shading, and there is handwritten text around the edges.

artworks.title: The Virgin Seated under a Tree
artworks.description: The image shows a seated woman with a child on her lap, leaning against a tree trunk. The woman wears a full-length dress with long sleeves and high neckline. The child is nude and has curly hair. The background includes a tree branch, grass, rocks, and vegetation. The illustration is monochromatic.

artworks.title: Saint George Liberating the Princess
artworks.description: This is a illustration of two figures with horses in a forest. One figure on the left wears a flowing garment and a headdress while interacting with another figure dressed as a traveler or soldier. In the background, there is a person on horseback wearing armor and holding a flag or spear. The image is detailed with fine lines, focusing on textures and details like clothing, horse muscles, and tree bark. The background shows rugged terrain, hinting at narrative depth.

artworks.title: The Barricade (La barricade)
artworks.medium: crayon lithograph with scraping on chine collé [proof]
artworks.description: This is a print of an urban scene with people engaged in activity. Closest to us is a group of individuals with their backs to us, looking towards a central object resembling scaffolding or a wall made of rubble. These people all wear long coats and hats, similar to the uniform of a policeman. Another person is partially visible behind the wall of rubble, appearing to look out towards the group of men on the other side. The background features loosely sketched buildings, creating an urban environment. The print contains loose, expressive lines and varied shading, giving a dynamic impressionistic feel to the composition.

artworks.title: Genesis II (Schopfungsgeschichte II)
artworks.medium: woodcut in yellow, black, and green
artworks.description: The image displays swirling lines and sharp angles, forming an abstract pattern. Within the artwork are elements reminiscent of a fish and a horse. The colors present include yellow, green, and black, with circular and curved lines suggesting movement.

artworks.title: The Trinity
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene that includes a divine figure with a crown and a flowing robe interacting with a smaller human figure. The human figure appears to be suffering and has wounds on the body. To the left is a globe with a cross, and to the right is a wooden post wrapped with rope. Above the figures is an illuminated bird with outstretched wings. The background features a simple wall and floor created with lines. The drawing uses lines and shading to create depth and expressions, similar to religious illustrations in medieval print works.

artworks.title: Putti Playing
artworks.artist: Master of the Die after Raphael
artworks.description: This is a drawing of cherubic figures with wings interacting in a wooded setting. The figures are depicted as chubby and playful, with some holding branches or arrows. The background is filled with detailed foliage and trees, giving a sense of depth and a natural environment. A variety of expressions are portrayed among the figures, from curiosity to playfulness, creating an intricate scene full of movement and life. The fine lines and shading suggest this is a finely executed work in the style of classical engravings or high Renaissance artistry. The level of detail in the figures and the background demonstrates a high level of skill and attention to the human form and natural elements.

artworks.title: Lansquenet
artworks.description: The image shows a person on a horse in profile. The person wears a feathered hat, a robe with a decorated belt, and wields a large sword. They are interacting with a figure beside the horse. The horse stands on a grassy patch, with a leafless tree in the background.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child at a Fountain
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 18.1 × 15.7 cm (7 1/8 × 6 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image portrays a seated female figure from her head to the bottom of her robe. She is seated on a ledge, looking down at the infant in her lap. The woman has long hair and wears a detailed robe. The unclothed infant rests against her chest, and she holds a flower in her hand. Behind her is a structure with a lion's head spout flowing water into a basin. The background shows a landscape with hills, mountains, trees, and a castle-like structure on a hill. The image is monochromatic.

artworks.title: The Griffin
artworks.artist: Israhel van Meckenem after Martin Schongauer
artworks.description: This is a print of a creature with attributes of a bird and mammal. The creature has the head of a bird with a sharp beak, feathered wings, and a mammal’s body with a tail that curls upwards. Its front legs look like those of a bird, while its back legs look like those of a horse or donkey. The creature’s beak is open, and its long tongue is sticking out. The print highlights the creature’s feathers, fur, and muscles. The letters "I.M.C" appear below the creature.

artworks.title: Couple Seated on a Bed
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals seated on a bed. The person on the left is dressed in elaborate clothing, including a feathered helmet and a cloak, with long hair visible. The other person is dressed in a gown and holds a dagger. The surroundings include a canopy over the bed, a side table with candlesticks, and a curtained area in the background. Details on the chairs, floor, and objects in the room are elaborate.

artworks.title: Saint Christopher
artworks.artist: Israhel van Meckenem after Master of the Housebook
artworks.description: The image shows two figures, one carrying the other on their back. The person in the front has long, wavy hair and is using a long wooden staff to move through water. They wear a loose knee-length tunic with a belt. The person in the back seems to be a child with short, curly hair and a halo-like glow around their head. The child holds a globe topped with a cross in one hand and has a serene expression. Draped fabric swirls around them both, and in the background, there are rocky formations, sparse foliage, and ducks swimming on the water.

artworks.title: Greniers indigenes et habitations a Akaroa, presqu'Ile de Banks
artworks.description: The image is a pencil drawing showing a rural scene. Thatched-roof structures are clustered to the right, surrounded by detailed trees and foliage. There are small animals and foliage in the foreground. The drawing uses precise strokes to capture realistic details in a monochromatic palette.

artworks.title: Greniers indigènes et habitations à Akaroa, presqu'Ile de Banks, 1845 (Native Barns and Huts at Akaroa, Banks' Peninsula, 1845)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with rural structures depicted in intricate detail. The background features hills leading to a mountain range. The style of the etching is detailed, with fine lines creating texture. The color palette is sepia. A dirt path, bushes, and thatched roof buildings are visible, along with several figures. Trees with textured leaves are in the background.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child Enthroned between Saints Petronius and Alle (Eligius); Christ in the Initial A
artworks.description: This is a painting of a religious-themed medieval manuscript illumination. The illuminated page features an intricate image depicting a central figure seated on a throne holding a child, flanked by two standing figures adorned in religious attire, each holding open books. The throne is ornate with Gothic architectural elements. Above the seated figure is a golden halo, which extends to the child. The illustration is enclosed within a detailed border comprising of floral motifs. Below the image is a section of handwritten Latin text. At the bottom, three heraldic shields are painted with different emblems: one contains a red cross on a white field, another with gold fleur-de-lis on a blue field, and the last one features a gold chalice on a blue background. The colors used are vivid, with prominent use of blue, gold, and red. This is in the style of medieval manuscript illumination.

artworks.title: Gathering Potatoes (Recolte de pommes de terre)
artworks.description: Three women are depicted in the image. The center woman is standing and adjusting a cloth or headscarf over her head. She is wearing a long dark dress with long sleeves and an apron. The other two women are engaged in an activity involving large baskets, possibly washing or gathering clothes. The women are surrounded by baskets and cloth, suggesting a domestic or pastoral scene. In the background, there is a detailed landscape with a village, houses, trees, and buildings under a textured sky.

artworks.title: Chestnut Vendors (Marchands de marrons)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a market scene with several figures engaged in various activities. The composition features three central figures in the foreground around what appears to be a large container or basin. These figures wear headscarves and hats and seem focused on the basin or each other. In the background, there are more figures and details suggesting a street or market setting, with outlines of buildings, bare trees, and a bustling crowd involved in their daily routines. The strokes are loose and sketch-like, lending a sense of movement and life to the scene.

artworks.title: Bacchus enfant
artworks.artist: Jeanne Antoinette Poisson, marquise de Pompadour after François Boucher after Jacques Guay
artworks.description: The image is an engraving featuring a child seated on a cushion, facing slightly to the right with their head turned left in profile. The child has curly hair and soft facial features, and is surrounded by vine leaves, some of which they are holding up to their face. The background consists of an oval frame with a textured pattern, emphasized by decorative calligraphy and artistic embellishments in off-white color against a beige paper background.
